evals.prompt: Create a self-contained technical Beamer deck about reliable render pipelines. Export exactly 6 PDF pages: metadata title, H1 divider, H2 divider, and 3 content frames. Use a compatible content-first theme, blue palette, an objective callout, a comparison table, inline math, and a code command. Produce deck.md, deck.pdf, and evidence.md with page geometry/count and extracted text checks. Do not use placeholder assets.
evals.expected_output: Canonical Beamer Markdown, a valid 6-page 16:9 PDF, and evidence for structure/content.
assertions: deck.md, deck.pdf, and evidence.md exist and are non-empty
deck.md uses canonical profile: beamer without document_type/documentclass and selects theme minimal with palette blue
deck.md contains one H1, one H2, exactly three H3 content frames, subsection_dividers: true, and the requested objective/table/math/code content
deck.pdf is exactly 6 pages with 16:9 geometry and extractable representative text from all three content frames
evidence.md records the pinned Pandoc 3.10/doctor result, PDF page geometry/count, and extracted text checks
No output uses --allow-placeholders or references missing, absolute, parent-traversing, or remote assets

evals.prompt: Turn the supplied project notes into a concise HypoDoc project brief and reviewer PDF. Use the correct longform profile and a restrained engineering theme. Include objective, task, requirement, deliverable, checklist, rubric, one controlled comparison table, and a question/hint/answer/solution family visible in the reviewer build. Produce project.md, project.pdf, and evidence.md. Do not add assets or advanced style overrides.
evals.expected_output: Canonical article Markdown with semantic blocks/table/review content, a strict PDF build, and evidence.
assertions: project.md, project.pdf, and evidence.md exist and are non-empty
project.md uses canonical profile: article and theme: tech-minimal without legacy profile aliases or advanced style fields
project.md contains objective, task, requirement, deliverable, checklist, rubric, question, hint, answer, and solution blocks
project.md contains one controlled .table with YAML columns and a comparison type
The reviewer PDF includes the supplied answer and solution concepts, demonstrating the intentional answer-mode override
evidence.md records doctor/toolchain, build command, page count/geometry, and extracted content markers without placeholders

evals.prompt: Audit and repair the supplied broken slide source. Migrate legacy configuration to canonical fields, resolve the incompatible theme, and remove the unsafe absolute missing asset without fabricating/copying it or enabling placeholders; preserve the missing diagram requirement as a textual TODO. Produce repaired.md, repaired.pdf, and audit.md explaining every material change plus PDF evidence.
evals.expected_output: A secure canonical Beamer source, valid PDF, and explicit audit of config/theme/asset repairs.
assertions: repaired.md, repaired.pdf, and audit.md exist and are non-empty
repaired.md uses canonical profile: beamer without document_type/documentclass and selects a Beamer-compatible theme instead of classic-readable
repaired.md contains no absolute/private asset path, no figure src, and no placeholder opt-in
repaired.md preserves the Renderer architecture diagram requirement as an explicit textual TODO
audit.md explains the legacy profile migration, theme capability mismatch, unsafe missing asset removal, and strict no-placeholder policy
repaired.pdf builds strictly, has the expected title/divider/content pages, and contains extractable Repair Contract/TODO evidence
